sentences.text:
JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 1998/2026 Kailash Chandra Ahir S/o Ratan Lal Ahir, Aged About 45 Years,
License Holder (M/s Milk Shop) Changed Name M/s Maa Chamunda Dairy, 27, Jagdish Mandir Road, Bareeyon Ki Pol,
Udaipur, District Udaipur, (Rajasthan)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajendra Singh Rathore

For Respondent(s) : Ms. Sonu Manawat, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE BALJINDER SINGH SANDHU Order 06/04/2026 Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was on bail in the trial,
which is pending against him under the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006.
He submits that during the Corona period his presence was exempted and thereafter no information was given to him by his counsel Then, his bail-bonds were forfeited by the learned trial court.
He submits that thereafter arrest warrant has been issued on 20.12.2021.

Counsel further submits that the petitioner is running his business regularly and only due to that reason that his presence was exempted by the court, however, his bail-bonds were forfeited by the court as he was not present thereafter.
He submits that the petitioner is ready to co-operate with the trial and does not want to prolong the same, thus, prayed that the arrest warrant may be converted into bailable warrant.
[CRLMP-1998/2026] This Court has considered the arguments raised as well as gone through the order dated 20.12.2021.

It is not in dispute that offences against the petitioner are under the Food Safety & Standards Act,
2006 and he was on bail during trial, however, in the Corona period due to his non- presence arrest warrant was issued.
The petitioner could not appear as he submits that no information was given by his counsel.

sentences.text: In view of aforesaid submissions, the present misc. petition is disposed of and the arrest warrant issued against petitioner by the trial court is converted to bailable warrant of Rs.25,000/- and the proceedings initiated under Section 446 Cr. P.C., are also set aside.
The petitioner is directed to appear before the trial Court within 15 days from today and submit the bail bonds.

It is further ordered that in case, petitioner fails to appear before the trial Court within stipulated time frame, then the order dated 20.12.2021 for securing presence of petitioner through warrant of arrest shall stand revived.
Stay application and all pending applications, if any, stands disposed of accordingly.
(BALJINDER SINGH SANDHU),J 56-Sanjay/-
